title: Bearing failure on conveyor drive motor
description: A conveyor drive motor showed rising temperature and vibration before a bearing seizure caused an unplanned shutdown.
observed_symptoms: Temperature rising above normal operating range
documented_root_cause: Lubrication starvation accelerated bearing wear and heat generation.
failure_mechanism: Bearing friction increased, causing heat, vibration, and eventual seizure.
outcome_or_impact: Production line stopped for 8 hours and repair cost exceeded threshold.
relevant_passage: The motor ran hotter than expected and bearing temperature increased before the seizure. Lubrication breakdown and dust contamination were observed.

title: Cavitation damaged centrifugal pump impeller
description: A pump repeatedly cavitated after suction conditions changed, leading to impeller pitting and reduced flow.
documented_root_cause: Insufficient suction head caused cavitation and impeller erosion.
failure_mechanism: Vapor bubbles collapsed near the impeller, producing localized impact damage.
outcome_or_impact: Pump efficiency fell and downstream process pressure became unstable.
source_title: Pump Cavitation and Impeller Erosion Review
relevant_passage: Cavitation occurred when the suction head fell below required conditions. The noisy pump had reduced discharge pressure and visible impeller pitting.
